As the result shows,among the thirty studentstaking part in the survey,most ofthem often buy snacks;about a half spend their pocket money on books, and a few save some ofit.

However,things on me are quitc different.I usually spend most of the money buying good and educational books which I think make me more knowledgeable.Only a small part is spent on snacks as most ofthe snacks are in fact unhealthy for us.And I save the rest against a rainy day.
